info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Investment Management E Trading Workbenchs-spec
info.description: The Investment Management E-Trading Workbench API provides access to a comprehensive list of e-trading workbench tools designed for investment management. Users can retrieve detailed information about various trading workbench configurations, helping them to optimize their trading strategies and manage investments effectively. This API is ideal for financial analysts, traders, and portfolio managers who require data-driven insights to enhance their trading activities. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline their e-trading operations and improve overall investment management efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the latest information and functionalities available in the e-trading workbench for investment management. Use this to get an overview of trading options, market data, and trading tools.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving data from the E-Trading Workbench in the investment management system. This body must be formatted as JSON and comply with the specified schema.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, returning the requested data.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes Bearer Authentication, where the client sends a security token as part of the request. The token is a JSON Web Token (JWT), which is a compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties. It allows for the authentication of users and the exchange of information.
